# EasyTech

> EasyTech provides friendly, local IT support and computer help across Metro Vancouver (Coquitlam, Burnaby, Surrey & Vancouver). Services include Wi-Fi & network support, phone/tablet setup, smart home device installation, home office setup, senior-friendly in-home tech support, small business IT assistance, IT strategy and purchasing consulting, computer support & device security, and website design & development.

## Pages

- [Home](https://easytechvancouver.ca/): Overview of IT support services, pricing, tech tips, and contact information for EasyTech.
- [Business IT Support](https://easytechvancouver.ca/business-it-support): IT services for small businesses in Metro Vancouver, including network security, Microsoft 365 & email migration, cloud backups, employee tech training, and IT strategy and purchasing consulting.
- [Senior Tech Support](https://easytechvancouver.ca/senior-tech-support): Patient, jargon-free in-home tech support for seniors, covering phones/tablets, computers, Smart TVs, and online safety/scam protection.
- [Contact](https://easytechvancouver.ca/contact): Request a free quote or book a service by phone, WhatsApp, or contact form.
- [Privacy Policy](https://easytechvancouver.ca/privacy-policy): What information EasyTech collects, how it's used, and your choices.
- [Terms of Service](https://easytechvancouver.ca/terms-of-service): The rules and conditions for using the site and EasyTech's services.
